registration.title: The shot formula
registration.what: Move the expected margin by a formula of five differences between the two sides' last ten matches: xG, shots, shots on target, shots in the box, and goals minus xG.
registration.why: About half of what the boosted trees gain is recent shots, and a formula can be written into production and explained on the site where trees cannot.
registration.how: A ridge regression of the margin's error on the five differences, refitted every 1 January and 1 July on earlier matches.
registration.hypothesis: A plain formula recovers most of the shots part of the trees' gain.

metrics.source: experiments/prospective/PROTOCOLS.md (P13): its figure on the 2022 to 2024 selection window

expected.confidence: Never scored on a match after June 2024.
expected.evidence: The trees' ablation, the shots-proxy experiment and the selection-window figure.

registration.success_criteria: Protocol P13 (secondary) and P14: better by 0.002 on prospective snapshots with the interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing and the goal markets no worse.
